speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong
text: asked 	the Minister for National Development (a) whether there are guidelines on the installation of barriers in void decks, walkways and other common spaces in terms of accessibility for the disabled, elderly and community activities; and (b) what is the Ministry's position on the installation of such barriers in common spaces in HDB estates.

speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong (Non-Constituency Member)
text: What are the avenues for the public if they have complaints about such barriers?

speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong (Non-Constituency Member)
text: Who can they turn to, to make the complaints?
